paragraphs: Lachma bar Luwai. Mentioned in the Zohar, Shemot 15b; see there.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: טו: is read as 15b under the colon convention, and ע״ש as “see there.” Hyman does not name a Zohar edition. Earlier machine OCR had מז:; this is not accepted as a printed variant.
The supplied patronymic לואי is retained as Luwai rather than normalized to לוי, Levi. The supplied first name is לחמא; earlier machine OCR had לחנא. The English vowels remain conventional.
This renders Hyman’s supplied citation; its occurrence and edition-specific locator have not been independently checked.
